## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Northern-Sòng annotated commentary by Zōngyì 宗翌 on Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* ([KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157), T1927). The composition is securely dated by Zōngyì's own preface to Xiánpíng 咸平 1 (= 998 CE).

**Abstract**

The work belongs together with Yuánqīng's *Shìzhū zhǐ* ([KR6d0160](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0160)) as one of the very earliest Sòng commentaries on Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén*, predating Zhīlǐ's foundational *Zhǐyào chāo* ([KR6d0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0158)) by three decades. The 998 dating places the work in the immediate aftermath of the Five Dynasties period and at the beginning of the Northern-Sòng Tiāntái revival.
